The '''Imperial convoy ship''' was a type of [[Imperial cargo ship]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Description==
[[File:Theft_of_the_Death_Star_II_weapons_systems_piece.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A cargo ship is [[Ambush on the Corellian Trade Spine|attacked]] by [[Wolf Squadron]].]]
The ship was shaped like a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], with a ridge going up to its bridge and had at least two thrusters. The hold could carry at least one [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]], sharing room with additional cargo. The ship was simple enough to fly that it could be done by only one crewmember.<ref name="The Will of Darth Vader" />

==History==
One such vessel carried a vital piece of the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II's]] weapons systems in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], when it was ambushed by [[Wolf Squadron]]. The crew were killed, and the ship was brought to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel's]] base on [[Annamar]]. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] later led a successful [[Battle of Annamar|mission]] to recover the craft and its valuable contents.<ref name="The Will of Darth Vader" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars Adventures: The Will of Darth Vader]]'' {{1st}}
